title: Asteroid H/G/diameter consumers: pheno + eclipse/riseset radius + goldens
description:
# Thread asteroid H/G/diameter into phenomena and eclipse/riseset radius; re-enable Ceres pheno coverage

## Summary
Consume the per-file `AsteroidMeta` (swisseph-rs/100) at every site that stubs C's `swed.ast_H/ast_G/ast_diam` today: pheno's Bowell §5k magnitude branch, pheno's §4 apparent diameter, `eclipse::body_radius_au`, and riseset's disc diameter. Re-enables the pheno golden coverage for Ceres..Vesta deferred from swisseph-rs/83 (shipped 120 cases instead of the spec'd 132) and adds numbered-asteroid pheno goldens.

## Files
- `src/context.rs` — `asteroid_meta` accessor on `Ephemeris`.
- `src/phenomena.rs` — §5k else-arm (line ~295-305) + §4 apparent-diameter stub (comment at line ~177).
- `src/eclipse.rs` — `body_radius_au` (line 166) + its 4 call sites (~242, ~489, ~2487, ~2821).
- `src/riseset.rs` — the ast_diam stub (~line 463, flagged in c-ref-asteroid.md §4.3's porting-implication note).
- `tests/c-gen/gen_pheno.c`, `tests/golden/pheno.rs` (extend).

## Implementation steps
1. **Accessor** (context.rs): `pub(crate) fn asteroid_meta(&self, body: Body) -> Option<&crate::sweph_file::AsteroidMeta>` — `Body::Asteroid(n)` → find in `self.asteroid_files` by `planets()[0].body_id == 10000 + n` → `header().asteroid.as_ref()`; every other body → `None`. Main asteroids (Chiron..Vesta) deliberately return `None`: C never populates the globals from seas files, and their magnitude/diameter data live in `MAG_ELEM` / `PLANETARY_DIAMETERS` (c-ref-asteroid.md §4.1, §4.3).
2. **pheno §5k** (phenomena.rs ~301): replace the `return Err(EphemerisNotAvailable)` arm with `let meta = eph.asteroid_meta(ipl).ok_or(Error::EphemerisNotAvailable { body, source: eph.config().ephemeris_source })?; [meta.h, meta.g]`. Keep the 1566-Icarus override arm ordered BEFORE it (C checks Icarus first — §4.1). Remove the now-stale TODO comment and update the fn doc (lines 103-106) that documents the gap.
3. **pheno §4 apparent diameter** (~177): numbered asteroids get `dd = meta.diameter_km * 1000.0` (km→m, NOT halved — downstream `attr[3]` computation divides, c-ref-asteroid.md §4.2 table, swe_pheno row). No meta → `dd = 0.0` point-source fallback (§4.2 fallback paragraph); in practice meta exists whenever calc succeeded for the body, since both read the same loaded file.
4. **`body_radius_au`** (eclipse.rs:166): change signature to take `eph: &Ephemeris` as first param; add the numbered-asteroid arm before the fallback: `meta.diameter_km / 2.0 * 1000.0 / AUNIT` (§4.2 table, eclipse_where row); keep starname→0.0 and the `PLANETARY_DIAMETERS` arm unchanged; unresolved meta → 0.0 (silent point-source, matching C). Update the 4 call sites (all have `eph` in scope) and delete the stub comment block (lines 174-177).
5. **riseset.rs ast_diam stub** (~463): same pattern, `dd = meta.diameter_km * 1000.0` not halved (§4.2 table, swe_rise_trans row), 0.0 fallback.
6. **gen_pheno.c**: switch `swe_set_ephe_path("../swisseph/ephe")` → `swe_set_ephe_path("ephe")` (run from repo root; `<repo>/ephe` is a superset — verify by regenerating that the existing 120 cases are BYTE-IDENTICAL, acceptance below). Add:
   - Main asteroids `SE_CHIRON, SE_PHOLUS, SE_CERES, SE_PALLAS, SE_JUNO, SE_VESTA` × the existing 4 epochs × `SWIEPH` only = 24 cases (SWIEPH-only for asteroids: the MOSEPH rows in this generator would poison/depend on process state per c-ref-asteroid.md §1.5 — add a comment saying exactly that so the constraint survives).
   - Numbered `SE_AST_OFFSET+433`, `+7066`, `+136199` × 4 epochs × `SWIEPH` = 12 cases. (All epochs are within the short files' 1500–2100 coverage; 2378500.5 > 2268922.5 ✓.)
   - Update the header comment (the long OMITTED paragraph, lines 6-16) — the gap it documents is now closed.
   - Total 120 + 36 = 156 cases.
7. **tests/golden/pheno.rs**: extend the body mapping for 15..=20 and `>= 10000` → `Body::asteroid(id - 10000)`; construct the Ephemeris with `ephe_path = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("ephe")` and `asteroid_numbers: vec![433, 7066, 136199]`; bump the count assertion to `>= 156`; keep the existing tolerances unchanged for old cases and apply them to the new ones. The Eros rows are the end-to-end verification of swisseph-rs/100's MPC parsing: its attr[4] depends on H=10.38/G=0.15 and attr[3] on the H-estimated diameter (blank field → 1329/√0.15·10^(−0.2H) ≈ 28.8 km).

## C reference
`docs/c-ref-asteroid.md` §4 (all three subsections — consumption sites, exact scaling expressions, the halved/not-halved split, population timing/staleness), §1.5 (why asteroid MOSEPH pheno rows are excluded from gen_pheno). `docs/c-ref-phenomena.md` §5k (Bowell expressions — already implemented, unchanged). No C source reading.

## Golden tests
- Rebuild/rerun gen_pheno per its header comment, from repo root.
- `cargo test --test golden pheno -- --nocapture`.

## Acceptance criteria
- `cargo test --test golden pheno -- --nocapture` passes with ≥156 cases at existing tolerances.
- Regenerated `pheno.json`: `git diff` shows the pre-existing 120 cases unchanged (pure addition). If ANY old case changes value, stop — the ephe-path switch changed inputs; report instead of committing.
- Full `cargo test --test golden` + `cargo test` pass (eclipse/riseset signatures ripple compiles everywhere).
- `cargo clippy --all-targets` clean.
- Both stub comments (phenomena.rs Bowell gap, eclipse.rs body_radius_au gap) and the gen_pheno OMITTED paragraph are gone.

## Escape hatch
If asteroid pheno magnitudes (attr[4]) or diameters (attr[3]) mismatch > 1e-8 after two attempts: report per-body expected/actual. Diagnostic split worth stating: main asteroids wrong → Bowell/MAG_ELEM path (pre-existing code, §5k); only numbered wrong → H/G/diam parsing (swisseph-rs/100) or the meta lookup; only attr[3] wrong → the halved/not-halved or km→m scaling (§4.2 table). Escalate to Opus.
execution_record: Implemented in two commits: (1) 37caedf — library-side: Ephemeris::asteroid_meta accessor + pheno/eclipse/riseset consumers. (2) 9993178 — gen_pheno.c extended to 156 cases, pheno.rs test updated. All 7 plan steps executed as-is, no deviations. No escape-hatch needed — all 36 new cases passed on first attempt.
